verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage claims an in-product assistant where you describe an audience, journey, or growth goal and it 'understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use' (docs-16/22). It also claims predictive scoring for churn, conversion, and value growth (docs-15) and audience expansion from strong customer behaviors (docs-13). These are AI-driven suggestions and predictions, but they rest only on short marketing lines, with no product docs or hands-on confirmation, and they focus on audience logic rather than broad insights. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the AI assistant and how it works, AI-generated insights beyond audience logic and scores (e.g. explanations or anomaly detection), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
